title: Targeting Cervical Epidural Spinal Cord Stimulation for Functional Recovery
official: Targeting Cervical Epidural Spinal Cord Stimulation for Functional Recovery
summary: The proposed study seeks to understand how the cervical spinal cord should be stimulated after injury through short-term physiology experiments that will inform a preclinical efficacy trial. The purpose of this study is to determine which cervical levels epidural electrical stimulation (EES) should target to recruit arm and hand muscles effectively and selectively in spinal cord injury (SCI).

interventions.name: Intraoperative stimulation of the cervical spinal cord

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

•Clinical indication for cervical spine surgery.

Exclusion criteria:

•Stimulation devices in the neck or chest (e.g., vagal nerve stimulation, cardiac patients with pacemakers)
